name: Cellframe LP migration calculation flaw
summary: The Cellframe LpMigration contract computes the new-token payout from the pool's current reserves at migration time instead of a fixed snapshot, so skewing the old CELL/WBNB pool with a flash loan first made the migration pay out far more.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
